transformation: Decoded and stitched TopoJSON arcs into SVG paths with coordinates rounded to two decimals. Preserves all 50 states plus District of Columbia. Original Albers USA projection with Alaska and Hawaii insets. Original bounds (-60,0,1040,620) uniformly scaled by 960/1040; coordinates translated 60 units right before scaling and vertically centered in 960x600. No distortion or clipping. Postal abbreviations are stable IDs; original FIPS retained separately. State abbreviations from USPS convention. Center is area centroid of the largest polygon and is for label placement only.
limitations: 2017 generalized state boundaries for national orientation, not current cadastral, territorial, or precision navigation use. Alaska and Hawaii are inset and not to the same map scale as the contiguous states. District of Columbia is included but is not a state. US territories are not represented in this inset projection.
